uniform_exact_gold_ceiling.note: Keeps one case from the duplicated citizens-initiative chunk. Uniform exact-chunk gold, but no regime balance.

option_a_strongest_practical.note: Only defensible if results are stratified by gold type; pooled answer-bearing coverage would be invalid.

option_b_most_balanced.note: More balanced wording, but not an expansion of all eight current cases and still confounds regime with gold granularity.

sp_probe_verdict.finding: Every inspected assertion-200, assertion-100, direct-chunk-40, and assertion-ablation-40 query uses the same quoted subject-predicate template.
sp_probe_verdict.risk: The template directly exposes gold E-R anchors to structured retrieval while presenting an unnatural phrase to dense chunk retrieval, creating the opposite bias rather than balancing the experiment.

recommendation_reason: Existing assets can raise n to 15 only by mixing exact-chunk, document-only, and absence gold while remaining 11-to-4 natural-heavy. A uniformly scored set reaches only 10 and remains entirely natural. The only large structured assets are artificial S/P probes that would bias the KG arm. Expansion would add size without resolving the methodological imbalance.
